events.name: New York Mets at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — A.J. Ewing hit a go-ahead, three-run homer, Ronny Mauricio went deep from both sides of the plate for his first career multi-homer game and the New York Mets defeated the Washington Nationals 7-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mets beat Nationals 7-1 behind 2 homers from Mauricio and 3-run drive by Ewing

headlines.description: — Justin Verlander made a teary farewell, accompanied by his 7-year-old daughter as he left a major league mound for the final time in the Detroit Tigers'...
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Verlander makes teary farewell to 21-year career as Tigers rally to beat Pirates 4-3

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — JJ Bleday hit a solo home run, Héctor Rodríguez added a two-run triple and the Cincinnati Reds beat the Toronto Blue Jays 5-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bleday hits 24th homer, Lowder pitches 6 innings for first win since August as Reds beat Blue Jays

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Kiké Hernández hit a tiebreaking home run leading off the ninth inning, Mookie Betts also homered and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the San Francisco Giants 4-3 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kiké Hernández hits tiebreaking home run leading off 9th to lift Dodgers over Giants 4-3

headlines.description: — Michael Harris II had two doubles and a pair of singles, leading the Atlanta Braves to an 8-3 win Saturday that assured the Miami Marlins of their third straight losing season and 15th in 17 years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Harris' 4 hits lift Braves to 8-3 win, assures Marlins 15th losing season in 17 years

headlines.description: — Danny Jansen homered and drove in two runs as the Texas Rangers pushed the AL West race to the final day of the regular season with a rain-delayed 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers push the AL West race to the final day of the regular season with a 6-2 win over the Twins

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Once again, the Cleveland Guardians are division champs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guardians clinch their 3rd straight AL Central crown with an 11-5 win over the Royals

events.name: Colorado Rockies at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — The Chicago White Sox had their hopes of winning the AL Central dashed when Hunter Goodman hit his 40th and 41st homers to lift the Colorado Rockies in a 9-6 win Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: White Sox lose 9-6 to Rockies, end chances of winning AL Central

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Milwaukee Brewers

headlines.description: — Brice Turang hit a go-ahead two-run homer and the Milwaukee Brewers beat the St. Louis Cardinals 3-2 on Saturday night for their major league-leading 102nd win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Turang's go-ahead homer lifts Brewers over Cardinals 3-2 for 102nd win

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Aaron Nola was hit hard on two days' rest and the Phillies' bullpen unraveled in a 12-1 loss to the Tampa Bay Rays on Saturday night, forcing...
headlines.shortLinkText: Phillies lose 4th straight game in last-week collapse, will play for NL wild card in season finale

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Manny Machado hit a three-run homer and the San Diego Padres beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 10-7 on Saturday to secure the No. 4 seed in the National League playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Machado homers as Padres beat D-backs 10-7 to clinch home field in wild-card round vs Cubs

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Taylor Ward put Seattle ahead with a pinch-hit two-run single in the seventh inning, J.P Crawford followed with two-run homer and the Mariners beat the Los Angeles Angels 8-4 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Taylor Ward drives in go-ahead run, J.P Crawford hits two-run homer as Mariners beat Angels 8-4

headlines.description: — Yordan Alvarez launched a three-run homer and the Houston Astros went deep five times Saturday night as they moved closer to a division title with a 13-2 victory over the Athletics.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yordan Alvarez goes deep as Astros hit 5 homers in 13-2 rout of A's to close in on AL West title
